/* Baim05Mapper.selectDailyUserLinkPolicyList */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SITE_NO AS siteNo , A.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn , A.DAY_LIMIT_CNT AS dayLimitCnt , CONCAT( A.CMPNY_CD , '-' , A.SITE_CD ) AS joinCd
, A.ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_CNT AS activeAccountCount FROM ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.SITE_NO , A.SITE_NM , IFNULL(B.USE_YN, 'N') AS USE_YN , B.DAY_LIMIT_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DAILY_USER_SLOT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND S.SLOT_STATUS = '02' ) AS ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_CNT FROM TB_SITE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER_LINK_POLICY B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} ) A
